abstract.p: The inside-outside algorithm is widely utilized in statistical models related to context-free grammars. It plays a key role in the EM estimation of probabilistic context-free grammars. In this work, we introduce an inside-outside algorithm for Probabilistic Lambek Categorical Grammar (PLCG). 1
